reason: I already pay a setter who works my inbox, and my first instinct is that AI DMs sound robotic and prospects can tell. No customer results and a card up front for a 3-day trial isn't enough for me to put my own Instagram on the line.
objection: Three days is not enough time to see if cold DMs written by AI get replies from real prospects, there are zero published results, and if I forget to cancel it's billed and final. I'm not risking my account or my setter's workflow on something nobody has proven yet.
would_change_my_mind: Real screenshots or numbers from agency owners like me showing reply and booked-call rates from the AI-written DMs, plus a longer trial or refund window so I can run a real week of outreach.
